meta.title: Bottoms Up
meta.description: Here's to authentic stoves, which may be vexing at times but also sincere.

units.rawText: At the Oasis, in the cafeteria kitchen.
units.displayText: At the Oasis, in the cafeteria kitchen.

spans.text: At the Oasis, in the cafeteria kitchen.

units.rawText: Beef lungs, beef stomach, beef intestines, beef small intestines, beef spleen...
units.displayText: Beef lungs, beef stomach, beef intestines, beef small intestines, beef spleen...

spans.text: Beef lungs, beef stomach, beef intestines, beef small intestines, beef spleen...

units.rawText: Star anise, dried citrus peel, cinnamon, Chinese licorice, tsao-ko, fennel...
units.displayText: Star anise, dried citrus peel, cinnamon, Chinese licorice, tsao-ko, fennel...

spans.text: Star anise, dried citrus peel, cinnamon, Chinese licorice, tsao-ko, fennel...

units.rawText: The ingredients are ready, but... are you really going to cook, Professor?
units.displayText: The ingredients are ready, but... are you really going to cook, Professor?

spans.text: The ingredients are ready, but... are you really going to cook, Professor?

units.rawText: It's not bad to cook from time to time.
units.displayText: It's not bad to cook from time to time.

spans.text: It's not bad to cook from time to time.

units.rawText: In any case, I'll need to show some sincerity if I want to persuade her to join us.
units.displayText: In any case, I'll need to show some sincerity if I want to persuade her to join us.

spans.text: In any case, I'll need to show some sincerity if I want to persuade her to join us.

units.rawText: Willow said she likes eating this, so I'll make this for her.
units.displayText: Willow said she likes eating this, so I'll make this for her.

spans.text: Willow said she likes eating this, so I'll make this for her.

units.rawText: Ah... Alright, then. I'll be here, so just call for me if you need a hand.
units.displayText: Ah... Alright, then. I'll be here, so just call for me if you need a hand.

spans.text: Ah... Alright, then. I'll be here, so just call for me if you need a hand.

units.rawText: I'm just making a bowl of beef tripe.
units.displayText: I'm just making a bowl of beef tripe.

spans.text: I'm just making a bowl of beef tripe.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, have you had beef tripe before?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, have you had beef tripe before?

spans.text: Speaking of which, have you had beef tripe before?

units.rawText: I don't recall it, so I don't think so?
units.displayText: I don't recall it, so I don't think so?

spans.text: I don't recall it, so I don't think so?

units.rawText: I kind of want to make you a bowl of it in real life.
units.displayText: I kind of want to make you a bowl of it in real life.

spans.text: I kind of want to make you a bowl of it in real life.

units.rawText: Ehhh?
units.displayText: Ehhh?

spans.text: Ehhh?

units.rawText: I think when the time comes, there shouldn't be so many troublesome things to worry about.
units.displayText: I think when the time comes, there shouldn't be so many troublesome things to worry about.

spans.text: I think when the time comes, there shouldn't be so many troublesome things to worry about.

units.rawText: Oasis Medical Department, at the neural cloud evaluation ward.
units.displayText: Oasis Medical Department, at the neural cloud evaluation ward.

spans.text: Oasis Medical Department, at the neural cloud evaluation ward.

units.rawText: Millau opens her eyes and stares blankly at the ceiling.
units.displayText: Millau opens her eyes and stares blankly at the ceiling.

spans.text: Millau opens her eyes and stares blankly at the ceiling.

units.rawText: Are you awake?
units.displayText: Are you awake?

spans.text: Are you awake?

units.rawText: Helloooo?
units.displayText: Helloooo?

spans.text: Helloooo?

units.rawText: Willow reaches out to wave her hand in front of Millau before the latter swats it away.
units.displayText: Willow reaches out to wave her hand in front of Millau before the latter swats it away.

spans.text: Willow reaches out to wave her hand in front of Millau before the latter swats it away.

units.rawText: Honestly, can't you let me just lie down for a bit?
units.displayText: Honestly, can't you let me just lie down for a bit?

spans.text: Honestly, can't you let me just lie down for a bit?

units.rawText: Hehe, sure I can, but you looked weird. I'm just glad you're okay.
units.displayText: Hehe, sure I can, but you looked weird. I'm just glad you're okay.

spans.text: Hehe, sure I can, but you looked weird. I'm just glad you're okay.

units.rawText: What did you see during the evaluation?
units.displayText: What did you see during the evaluation?

spans.text: What did you see during the evaluation?

units.rawText: I saw some memory data of the past, like what humans call "dreams", I guess.
units.displayText: I saw some memory data of the past, like what humans call "dreams", I guess.

spans.text: I saw some memory data of the past, like what humans call "dreams", I guess.

units.rawText: And when I woke up, I was thinking, "wouldn't it be nice if this was just a dream too."
units.displayText: And when I woke up, I was thinking, "wouldn't it be nice if this was just a dream too."

spans.text: And when I woke up, I was thinking, "wouldn't it be nice if this was just a dream too."

units.rawText: Yeah, I understand. I was thinking of home too.
units.displayText: Yeah, I understand. I was thinking of home too.

spans.text: Yeah, I understand. I was thinking of home too.

units.rawText: It's all because of you and Uncle Lin, otherwise I wouldn't be thinking about this so much.
units.displayText: It's all because of you and Uncle Lin, otherwise I wouldn't be thinking about this so much.

spans.text: It's all because of you and Uncle Lin, otherwise I wouldn't be thinking about this so much.

units.rawText:
The longing for home is embedded in the depths of every neural cloud. 
If we hadn't triggered it, then you'd have triggered it yourself somewhere else sooner or later.
units.displayText:
The longing for home is embedded in the depths of every neural cloud. 
If we hadn't triggered it, then you'd have triggered it yourself somewhere else sooner or later.

spans.text:
The longing for home is embedded in the depths of every neural cloud. 
If we hadn't triggered it, then you'd have triggered it yourself somewhere else sooner or later.

units.rawText: I guess...
units.displayText: I guess...

spans.text: I guess...

units.rawText: Millau sniffs, and then slaps her face hard.
units.displayText: Millau sniffs, and then slaps her face hard.

spans.text: Millau sniffs, and then slaps her face hard.

units.rawText: Whap—
units.displayText: Whap—

spans.text: Whap—

units.rawText: Alright, that'll do. I was being too nostalgic because you two twisted my emotions.
units.displayText: Alright, that'll do. I was being too nostalgic because you two twisted my emotions.

spans.text: Alright, that'll do. I was being too nostalgic because you two twisted my emotions.

units.rawText: Your mouth says no, but the truth is you didn't actually mind revisiting those memories, did you?
units.displayText: Your mouth says no, but the truth is you didn't actually mind revisiting those memories, did you?

spans.text: Your mouth says no, but the truth is you didn't actually mind revisiting those memories, did you?

units.rawText: Well... I guess.
units.displayText: Well... I guess.

spans.text: Well... I guess.

units.rawText: If only I could have some beef tripe now.
units.displayText: If only I could have some beef tripe now.

spans.text: If only I could have some beef tripe now.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: The ward door opens again and the Professor enters, wreathed by a fragrant scent.
units.displayText: The ward door opens again and the Professor enters, wreathed by a fragrant scent.

spans.text: The ward door opens again and the Professor enters, wreathed by a fragrant scent.

units.rawText: Here's the beef tripe. How's that for sincerity?
units.displayText: Here's the beef tripe. How's that for sincerity?

spans.text: Here's the beef tripe. How's that for sincerity?

units.rawText: Mhm, thank you for your consideration. I'll give it a taste.
units.displayText: Mhm, thank you for your consideration. I'll give it a taste.

spans.text: Mhm, thank you for your consideration. I'll give it a taste.

units.rawText: Millau accepts the beef tripe without any hesitation and tries it.
units.displayText: Millau accepts the beef tripe without any hesitation and tries it.

spans.text: Millau accepts the beef tripe without any hesitation and tries it.

units.rawText: How does it taste?
units.displayText: How does it taste?

spans.text: How does it taste?

units.rawText: ...Frankly speaking, it's kind of ordinary.
units.displayText: ...Frankly speaking, it's kind of ordinary.

spans.text: ...Frankly speaking, it's kind of ordinary.

units.rawText: Ahem, but you ARE happy with it, right?
units.displayText: Ahem, but you ARE happy with it, right?

spans.text: Ahem, but you ARE happy with it, right?

units.rawText: Ultimately, Magrasea isn't our home, and if we want to go back to reality, we need to be united.
units.displayText: Ultimately, Magrasea isn't our home, and if we want to go back to reality, we need to be united.

spans.text: Ultimately, Magrasea isn't our home, and if we want to go back to reality, we need to be united.

units.rawText: But unlike reality, you'll eventually be able to try all the food in the cloud server, right?
units.displayText: But unlike reality, you'll eventually be able to try all the food in the cloud server, right?

spans.text: But unlike reality, you'll eventually be able to try all the food in the cloud server, right?

units.rawText: Millau stares hard at the Professor for a bit, and then she nods.
units.displayText: Millau stares hard at the Professor for a bit, and then she nods.

spans.text: Millau stares hard at the Professor for a bit, and then she nods.

units.rawText: To think you'd even comply with such a trivial request of mine. I guess it's like Willow said; you're a reliable person.
units.displayText: To think you'd even comply with such a trivial request of mine. I guess it's like Willow said; you're a reliable person.

spans.text: To think you'd even comply with such a trivial request of mine. I guess it's like Willow said; you're a reliable person.

units.rawText: ...Still, if I end up staying, I want that chocolate!
units.displayText: ...Still, if I end up staying, I want that chocolate!

spans.text: ...Still, if I end up staying, I want that chocolate!

units.rawText: Of course. The promise still stands, you can have as much chocolate as you want. You may also go out on dispatch to other sectors and try the food that the Oasis doesn't have.
units.displayText: Of course. The promise still stands, you can have as much chocolate as you want. You may also go out on dispatch to other sectors and try the food that the Oasis doesn't have.

spans.text: Of course. The promise still stands, you can have as much chocolate as you want. You may also go out on dispatch to other sectors and try the food that the Oasis doesn't have.

units.rawText: Hehe, looks like I kept my side of the promise we made when we parted ways.
units.displayText: Hehe, looks like I kept my side of the promise we made when we parted ways.

spans.text: Hehe, looks like I kept my side of the promise we made when we parted ways.

units.rawText: Whenever we meet again, you'll show me new food, and I'll bring you a new story...
units.displayText: Whenever we meet again, you'll show me new food, and I'll bring you a new story...

spans.text: Whenever we meet again, you'll show me new food, and I'll bring you a new story...

units.rawText: It's your turn now.
units.displayText: It's your turn now.

spans.text: It's your turn now.

units.rawText: Of course, I've got lots of stories in store!
units.displayText: Of course, I've got lots of stories in store!

spans.text: Of course, I've got lots of stories in store!

units.rawText: But before that...
units.displayText: But before that...

spans.text: But before that...

units.displayText: Willow takes a picture of Millau and the Professor together before putting her camera down and spreading her arms wide.

units.rawText: Millau pauses for a moment, and then she smiles brightly before gathering her long lost friend into a big hug.
units.displayText: Millau pauses for a moment, and then she smiles brightly before gathering her long lost friend into a big hug.

spans.text: Millau pauses for a moment, and then she smiles brightly before gathering her long lost friend into a big hug.

units.rawText: Welcome to the Oasis, Millau.
units.displayText: Welcome to the Oasis, Millau.

spans.text: Welcome to the Oasis, Millau.

units.rawText: Oh, don't worry, I won't hold back, so you'd better take me to try everything in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Oh, don't worry, I won't hold back, so you'd better take me to try everything in the Oasis.
